description: [Requires login] Post a new comment on an AniList forum thread from the authenticated user's account, or update an existing one by passing its `id`.

comment.description: The comment text to post (markdown; per AniList's own schema, up to 12000 characters).

id.description: Comment ID to update instead of creating a new one. Not the comment you're replying to — that's `parentCommentId`.

parentCommentId.description: Reply to this specific comment instead of posting top-level (from get_thread_comments). The reply then appears nested under that comment's `childComments` in get_thread_comments, not as a new top-level entry. Not the comment being edited — that's `id`.

threadId.description: AniList thread ID to comment on (from get_thread/search_thread).

name: post_thread_comment
title: Post a comment on a forum thread
